testResults.name: deployment-contract-tests
testResults.command: uv run --extra dev --with pyyaml python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/thesis/operations/test_deployment_contract.py
testResults.result: 20 tests: digest-pinned image reference enforced, thesis-api-bearer-token secretRef with no plaintext value, three /health probes, scale-to-zero defaults, identity parameterization, Log Analytics diagnostics, container-per-workspace isolation model, additive deployThesis-gated main.bicep wiring, bicepparam sentinel, deploy-thesis.yml YAML validity with pinned action SHAs and no committed secrets
